narrative: On the bookwheel. Samuel Daniel's book lies open in both hands at Waterson's stall, at the second book. The same king, and the same cousin, in grave smooth stanzas. He is still standing. No line is copied out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the second book on his feet, and gave in.

entities.name: Civil Wars
entities.context: Shown on book in The second book standing
